 MAI Image 2.7: Frontier quality at a fraction of the cost

 Nov 17, 2026

Today we’re introducing MAI Image 2.7 and MAI Image 2.7 Flash, delivering frontier image generation and editing at a fraction of the cost of the leading competitors. We’re also launching Canvas [https://labs.microsoft.ai/?model=canvas], a new interactive workspace powered by our Flash model to create, edit, and refine images.

MAI Image 2.7 takes the #1 spot on Artificial Analysis image editing, outperforming GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst (max) at just one-fifth of the cost. On Arena, MAI is a top-two lab in both image generation and editing, outperforming GPT Image 2.6 Flare 1 [#fn-1]. Flash delivers the speed and efficiency needed for production workloads, with both models on the quality-cost Pareto frontier for image generation and editing.

Available in public preview on Microsoft Foundry, MAI Image 2.7 costs ~$35 per 1,000 images while Flash costs ~$10 per 1,000 images.2 [#fn-2]

 

Fine-grained edit control

Change an object’s color, material, or position without disrupting the rest of an image. MAI Image 2.7 preserves visual consistency across successive edits, allowing creators to refine results and explore variations without starting over.

 

Both models support transparent backgrounds for ready-to-use product images, logos, icons, and illustrations without manual cutouts or cleanup.

 

Create and refine with Canvas

Canvas is a new interactive experience in MAI Labs, powered by MAI Image 2.7 Flash. Start with a prompt or sketch, turn rough ideas into polished diagrams, then select any part of an image to replace, move, or restyle – all in one space.

 

Built for creators and developers

MAI Image is now the default model family powering Bing Image Creator [https://www.bing.com/images/create/ai-image-generator], with usage growing at a compounded weekly rate of ~15% since June.2 [#fn-2]

Creative platforms and businesses including Adobe, Figma Weave, Minute (Sports Illustrated), Wirestock, and Manus are also working with MAI Image.

Get started

Try MAI Image 2.7 and MAI Image 2.7 Flash in MAI Labs [https://labs.microsoft.ai/?model=mai-image-2-7-flash], including Canvas [https://labs.microsoft.ai/?model=canvas].

Both models are available in public preview through Microsoft Foundry [https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/products/ai-foundry] and partners including fal [https://fal.ai/explore/search], Genspark [https://www.genspark.ai/], OpenRouter [https://openrouter.ai/models], and Vercel [https://vercel.com/].

 

 “ 
Adobe Firefly, our AI creative studio, gives creators choice of leading models and tools as they move from idea to finished content, and Microsoft AI Image 2.7 within that will give creators another option to tailor their images with strong prompt adherence.

 Matt Chotin
 Senior Director of Product, Adobe

 “ 
At Minute, we're constantly exploring new technologies that can strengthen our creative capabilities across brands like Sports Illustrated. In our early testing of Microsoft's MAI Image models, we were particularly impressed by the visual quality, composition and precision of targeted design edits. We see exciting potential for these models to help our teams develop creative concepts, explore ideas and refine designs, while maintaining the creative control and standards our brands are known for.

 Noy Freedman
 SVP of Strategic Alliances, Minute

 “ 
We’re excited to bring MAI Image 2.7 to Figma Weave. We built Weave to give teams more space for creative exploration and more control to bring their vision to life. Adding Microsoft’s latest image model unlocks new ways for our community to push their creativity further with Weave.

 Itay Schiff
 Creative Director of Figma Weave

 “ 
MAI-Image-2.7 reads a scene the way a photographer does. It's excellent at understanding scenes, preserving details, and making realistic changes to objects, lighting, angles, and backgrounds. Across a diverse set of real world tasks evaluated by the team at Wirestock, a leading visual training data provider, 2.7 shows a genuine leap forward for AI image editing.

 Eric Ghazarian
 Head of Content at Wirestock

 “ 
In our testing, MAI Image 2.7 delivered compelling stylized images, carried key visual elements over faithfully from reference images, and made localized edits that were accurate, consistent and quick.

 Tao Zhang
 Co-founder & CPO, Manus

About these results

Results reflect specific model configurations and evaluations. Performance, speed, and cost comparisons vary by workload and methodology.

Artificial Analysis and Arena: As of November 16, 2026, MAI Image 2.7 ranks #1 on AA-Image-Editing v2.1, scoring 1,215 Elo across 5,478 votes, ahead of GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst (max) by 4 Elo. Category rankings are based on Artificial Analysis’s editing-action evaluations. On Arena, MAI Image 2.7 is a top-2 lab across image generation [https://arena.ai/leaderboard/image/text-to-image] and single image editing [https://arena.ai/leaderboard/image/image-edit/single-image], surpassing GPT-Image-2.6-Flare across leaderboards.

Bing Image Creator: MAI Image became the default model family powering Bing Image Creator following the Build event in June. Usage grew at a reported compound weekly rate of 14.7%.
